query:
SELECT j.id, j.description, j.status, j.competenceMonth, j.createdAt,
  GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ae.entryType, ':', ae.amount) SEPARATOR ' | ') as entries
FROM journals j
LEFT JOIN accountingEntries ae ON ae.journalId = j.id
WHERE j.competenceMonth = '2026-01'
  AND (j.description LIKE '%Outra Receita%' OR j.description LIKE '%Outras Receitas%' OR j.description LIKE '%Pronampe%')
GROUP BY j.id
ORDER BY j.id
